notes.title: "Star of Lemutia : Reborn "have added to the library
notes.notes: Hi, we have added the new "Star of Lemuria: Reborn" to the library of users who have purchased 'Star of Lemutia' for free. Let's play now. If you have any questions, please leave a message.

notes.title: The new "Star of Lemutia : Reborn" will be released on December the 20th.
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce that  the new  "Star of Lemutia : Reborn" is set for take off and will be released to the public on December the 20th. 

This is a new and unique tactical game. The gameplay is very challenging.  Anything can happen when your heart is pumping so fast and sweat is running down your face.  Keep your mind set in the task at hand.  These battlefields change and develop faster than you can blink your eyes and each battle requires you to make the right decisions.   

There will be moments to launch a full attack other times you may need to retreat.  As always in battle, sacrifices must be made. Not all of your mercenaries will survive the journey.   Your weapons are powerful.  Use them well and with wisdom and timing.  


   Add this game to your wishlist and do whatever you must do while waiting for this thrilling and epic adventure to be in the palm of your hands.

notes.title: The game will be removed from the store in the near future
notes.notes:
Hello

Thank you for your love and attention to "Star of Lemutia" over the last two years. We didn't post updates in that time because we felt the game had so much potential and yet had not reached it yet. So we decided to start over,  We have taken this time to produce more than just an update, but a new game that was reborn.

The new game is called ‘Star of Lemutia : reborn’ has been redesigned and enhanced to feature new  graphics, new characters with amazing signature moves, and a completely new feel of excitement and adventure for you, the user.  It was your reviews and comments that helped guide our work to improve the game experience in every aspect.  Although it took a long time to get here, we believe the wait has been well worth it and now we are ready to launch the all new ‘Star of Lemutia : reborn.  We will be removing the current version of the game.players who have already purchased "Star of Lemutia" will receive a steam key for the new game. so that all users, new and old can experience what we always had dreamed this new game would be.  Now, that game is ready and it is with great joy and excitement that it becomes available to you.  We thank you all for your past and future support and wish you a safe and heroic journey through the magical world of Lemutia

The new game will be online in the near future and you can find out more information in the store.  Stay tuned!


嗨，

感谢各位两年来对《Star of Lemutia》的喜欢和关注。在这段时间里我们没有发布更新，因为我们认为本游戏潜力巨大，但尚未实现。 所以我们决定重新开始，我们花了这段时间来制作的不仅仅是更新，而是一个脱胎换骨的新游戏。

新游戏“Star of Lemutia：reborn”，经过重新设计和增强，具有新的图形，带有惊人招牌绝招的新角色以及给您（用户）一种全新的刺激和冒险感觉。正是您的评论和意见帮助指导我们在各个方面改善游戏体验。 尽管到达这里花了很长时间，但我们相信等待是值得的，现在我们准备推出全新的“Star of Lemutia : reborn”了。

我们将删除当前版本的游戏。已经购买了“Star of Lemutia”的玩家将获得新游戏的蒸汽钥匙。 这样，所有新老用户都可以体验我们一直梦寐以求的这款新游戏。 现在，该游戏已经准备就绪，非常高兴和激动，您可以使用它。 我们感谢大家的过去和将来的支持，并希望您安全，英勇地穿越魔幻世界

新作商店将在近期上线，您可以了解到更多的信息，敬请期待！

notes.title: Release 1.1.0（13 mar 2018）
notes.notes:
Hello!　

In this version, we have optimized the hero's manipulation of the mercenary, which is more simple and efficient. At the same time redesigned the tutorial, more straightforward and easy to understand. In addition, some interfaces are also beautified. The specific update is as follows:

- The mercenary's control is optimized for "one-click control". All mercenary orders use only [D] key, which is much simpler and more efficient.
- Re-created tutorials, improved operability, and more user-friendly.
- Fixed several BUGs in the previous version.
- Replaced some of the UI images to beautify the interface.

Thanks for the support and to everyone who helped us out.
And if you haven't yet left us a review, please consider taking some time to write a few words, heroes love reviews!
